title: What did each model see, and what did it play?

blocks.p: Every scored decision, 50 to a page: the board, the position exactly as the model saw it, every legal play with its consequences, the engine's equity for each play, the equity the chosen play lost and the model's probability where it gives one. Click a column header to sort a play table.
